text: DUSK: the grave-keeper wakes. the barrow road is open.
A BELL TOLLS: the BONE ABBOT walks to meet you.
THE HOLLOW KING rises. the dead kneel.
the lantern gutters. the road remembers every pilgrim.
coin and bone lie in the mud. the dead do not need them.
imps gnaw the milestones. the barrow wakes.
cultists chant from the treeline. they have your name.
a hanged sign reads: DO NOT WAKE THE OGRES.
THE HOUR TURNS: the graves open. brace yourself.
bone warders stand in the gate. what do they guard?
THE HOUR TURNS: more rise from the old plague pit.
the abbot is silent. his skull turns to follow you.
THE HOUR TURNS: rats pour from the crypt in a spiral.
your hands are steady. you are no longer the one who came.
THE LAST HOUR: the dead spend their whole host.
the bells stop. something older walks the road.
